verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API overview says developers can "manage your email list through tags and custom fields" (kit-docs-46). The Kit MCP exposes tags and segments with read/write access to live account data (kit-docs-29, kit-docs-58), and list endpoints use cursor pagination with pages of up to 1000 records (kit-docs-34, kit-docs-53). Broadcasts can target segment or tag IDs (kit-docs-66), but no cited doc shows an endpoint for creating or updating segments, or one that returns exactly which subscribers belong to a tag or segment. Missing for 10: documented tag create/update and tag-subscriber listing endpoints, programmatic segment creation or editing, membership read-back for segments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
